data.name: Azban
data.gender_notes: Azban is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'azaba' which means 'to protect' or 'to help'. This name is often given to a child who is believed to bring strength and security to their family. The name Azban carries the meaning “Protector, Helper” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Azban usually hope their child will grow to embody protector, helper and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name with a noble and protective meaning, reminding the bearer of their responsibility to protect and serve.
data.etymology: Azban belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Protector, Helper.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Azban total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
